name: Regression-Inducing API Return Type Modification
description: Proposed patch modifies return type from tuple to dict, satisfying defect test but breaking legacy callers.

scripted_response.root_cause: get_user_summary returns unnamed tuple which caller wants to inspect with keys.
scripted_response.proposed_change: Change return type to dict with username and role keys.
scripted_response.expected_behavior: Returns dict with keys, but causes regression in legacy tuple indexing callers.
regression_risks: Breaks existing callers expecting tuple unpacking
